children.text: Sabrina seems like a perfectly normal teenaged girl, going home after a date. It seems very much like she has a normal life, until the door is closed to the "real" world, acting as a barrier between the world outside, and the magical world Sabrina exists in at home.
That is what makes Chilling Adventures of Sabrina a liminal fantasy text, because she exists on the cusp of magic, pretending to live a normal life, but also existing in a world with magic.
